title: Assessment of Antimicrobial Activity
author: Elizabeth Ortiz-Vázquez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tg9ejz6

steps.title: Grow microbial strains
steps.instruction: Inoculate each strain on LB‑Agar plates and incubate at 37 °C for 12–24 h; alternatively, maintain cultures in Luria Broth at 37 °C and store in 20 % glycerol at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare colony suspension
steps.instruction: Pick three colonies of each strain and suspend them in 990 µL of 0.85 % NaCl (saline) solution.

steps.title: Adjust inoculum density
steps.instruction: Adjust the suspension to 1 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹ (≈0.5 McFarland), giving an absorbance of 0.10 (bacteria) or 0.12 (Candida albicans) at 600 nm.

substeps.instruction: If the density is below the target, add one additional colony to the suspension.
If the density exceeds the target, perform a serial dilution with saline.
Re‑measure absorbance at 600 nm after adjustment.

steps.title: Dilute inoculum for disk diffusion
steps.instruction: Dilute the adjusted inoculum with saline to a final concentration of 1 × 10⁶ CFU mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Plate inoculum
steps.instruction: Spread the diluted inoculum uniformly over agar plates and let it settle for 5 min.

steps.title: Apply test samples to disks
steps.instruction: Place sterile paper disks on the seeded plates and pipette 10–100 µL of each plant‑extract sample onto the disks.

substeps.instruction: Include sterile water and ampicillin disks as negative and positive controls.

steps.title: Incubate diffusion plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 37 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Measure inhibition zones
steps.instruction: Observe transparent halos around the disks and measure the diameter of each inhibition zone.

steps.title: Set up microdilution wells
steps.instruction: In each well add 250 µL of 2X Mueller‑Hinton broth, 50–170 µL of extract (desired concentration), 50 µL of inoculum, and sterile water to bring the total volume to 500 µL.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a control well containing broth, extract and water but no inoculum.

steps.title: Incubate microdilution plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the microdilution plates at 37 °C for 12 h.

steps.title: Read optical density
steps.instruction: Measure the optical density at 600 nm for each well to determine microbial growth.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the entire microdilution assay five times for each extract concentration.
